package.name: anubis_localization
package.description: HDL-style (koide3 hdl_localization lineage) NDT/GICP localization for Anubis, with global relocalization (scan_descriptor retrieval), manual RViz initial-pose, and AprilTag-anchor bootstrap/correction -- three independent ways to establish or fix the robot's pose in map frame, all converging on the same PoseEstimator re-anchor mechanism. Built by bulk-copying darmawan_ws's proven localization stack (namespace kept as `localization` internally -- see README.md for why) and surgically rewriting only the ArUco-coupled anchor correction to use AprilTag + a TF lookup instead of a hand-maintained extrinsic matrix.
